scope: Synthetic release transactions, real storage/backup helpers; no provider or user profile
checks: prepared and cancelled paper has no stored journey or start clock
gesture time sets s and concurrent/repeated commits save exactly once
pack failure cannot save and preserves retry with a new release timestamp
cancellation during compression prevents any durable write
stale prepared weather stops before packing or saving
storage failure does not report committed; explicit retry can succeed
failed critical write keeps draft; failed cleanup still commits one durable journey
draft survives reload and backup/import; never counts as a sent letter
corrupt draft is rejected before import changes persisted data
